description.title: פוליסת מכלול - פרק שבע
description.summary: This table defines the insured event for Chapter Seven of the 'Mecholal' insurance policy, covering employee injury or death. It details conditions for coverage related to accidents, occupational diseases, and continuous risk exposure.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת מכלול מכסה נזק גופני, נפשי או פסיכולוגי, או מחלת מקצוע, או מוות, שנגרמו לעובד כתוצאה מתאונה או מחלת מקצוע. הכיסוי חל על אירועים המתרחשים במהלך העבודה וקשורים לעיסוקו של העובד, ואינם חריגים. במקרה של סיכון מתמשך, חברת הביטוח תישא בחלק יחסי מהאחריות, בהתאם לתקופת החשיפה של העובד לגורם הנזק.
description.row_axis: Definition of insured event and conditions for Chapter Seven
notable_values: limit of liability: 50,000 NIS per occurrence

sketch:
1. Definition of the insured event for Chapter Seven
Physical, mental or psychological impairment or an occupational disease or death, suffered by an employee or employees who work for the insured, as a result of an accident or an occupational disease, which independently of any other factor, constitute the direct and main cause of the impairment, illness or death as aforementioned, which occur in the course of and as a result of his/ their at the insured's business and in the scope of the insured's occupation, which are not excluded by the general exclusions to the policy and/or by the exclusions listed hereunder in regard to this chapter.
Continuous risk: where the insured's liability arises from an accident or illness, which was caused by exposure of the employee to a continuous physical or tangible risk (hereinafter in this condition "the cause of the damage") in the course of and as a result of working at the business, the insurer will bear a pro-rata part of the liability, according to the ratio between the period of the employee's exposure to the cause of the damage in the course of the insurance period under this policy, and the period of the employee's exposure to the cause of the damage in general.
